native_visual_review.status: Completed selected-native visual review:52new PNGs actually viewed plus12 identical-file RawNIND controls from earlier viewed publication. Full-frame integrity is separate from exhaustive full-frame visual review.

notes.full427: Fabric color close to GT, fine cords smoothed away. Building outline restored but softer than GT; fine cloud wisps lost. Consistent with earlier genuine CPU pilot, not proof of full benchmark quality or broad superiority.
notes.known: Plate surface texture is smoothed; curved bright reflection remains but is simplified. In the second crop the small bright point and panel boundary remain, with softened transitions. AHD reference is independently demosaiced, not exact RGB GT.
notes.unseen: Apples/tan surfaces become smooth with mild broad patchiness. Broad color boundaries remain; fine texture is faint. No decisive detail advantage is established by these two selected ROIs. Independent AHD reference is not exact RGB GT.
notes.analytic: Both V43 and Nonlocal almost erase the dark carrier. The brighter weak carrier is faint in both, with low-frequency variation; amplitude remains visibly below analytic GT. Both neutral flats look smooth; saturated-color accuracy needs the separate colored-field checks.
notes.gfx: All16 new full-frame crop PNGs viewed. V43 fence wires are smoother/more regular than Nonlocal; Nonlocal retains more residual grain. RawNIND fence is more blurred. Fine foliage/truss remain soft in V43 and Nonlocal; separate ISO100 reference has different exposure/aperture/motion and is not GT. No broad real-photo winner.
notes.three-camera: All24 new triplets viewed. Q2 dark broad texture is similarly smoothed in V43/Nonlocal/RawNIND; no decisive detail gain. Sony panel grain is reduced and already-soft window outlines remain soft. GF50R Nonlocal retains more grain in stone than V43 while both preserve more fine surface variation than RawNIND; no exact GT is available.

analytic.limitations: Known horizontal carriers are an artificial task; false-band/peak metrics quantify residual energy, not a complete hallucination detector. GPU FP16 results are not exact replay of earlier CPU FP32 neural scores. Full photo/real/GFX review remains required.

selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.
